description_en: Disables multiple rules at a time so that the rules enter the INACTIVE state
description_zh: 批量停用指定规则，使规则处于“已停用”状态
name: StopConfigRules

parameters.help_en: The rule IDs. Separate multiple rule IDs with commas (,). You can specify a maximum of 20 rule IDs at a time
parameters.help_zh: 规则ID。多个规则ID之间以英文逗号（,）分隔，且不能超过20个
parameters.name: config_rule_ids
